title: Collidable Exemptions
description:
Gets a mutable set of UUIDs of the entities which are exempt from the entity's collidable rule and which's collision with this entity will behave the opposite of it.
For example if collidable is true and an entity is in the exemptions set then it will not collide with it.
Similarly if collidable is false and an entity is in this set then it will still collide with it.

description: Get the max nearby entities allowed for a spawner to spawn entities.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [creature] spawner max[imum] nearby entities of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] [creature] spawner max[imum] nearby entities

title: Spawner Max Spawn Delay
description: Get the max spawn delay of a spawner.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [creature] spawner max[imum] spawn delay of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] [creature] spawner max[imum] spawn delay

title: Spawner Min Spawn Delay
description: Get the min spawn delay of a spawner.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [creature] spawner min[imum] spawn delay of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] [creature] spawner min[imum] spawn delay

title: Spawner Radius
description: Get the spawner spawn count of a spawner.

title: Spawner Required Nearby Players
description: Get the required nearby players for a spawner to spawn.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [creature] spawner required [nearby] player[s] [count] of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] [creature] spawner required [nearby] player[s] [count]

title: Spawner Spawn Count
description: Get the spawner spawn count of a spawner.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [creature] spawner spawn count of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] [creature] spawner spawn count

title: Steerable Boost
description: Get the boost time of a steerable entity such as a pig or strider. This can be added, set or removed.

title: Steerable Item
description: Get the item used to steer a steerable entity such as a pig or strider.

title: Tropical Fish Pattern Colour
description: Grab the pattern colour of tropical fishes.
syntax_pattern:
[the] [tropical] fish pattern colo[u]r of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] [tropical] fish pattern colo[u]r

title: Villager Experience
description: Gets the trading experience of villagers.

title: Villager Level
description: Gets the level of villagers.

title: Villager Profession
description: Gets the profession of villagers.

title: Villager Type
description: Gets the type of villagers. Plains, Snow etc.

title: Warden Anger
description: Get the anger level of warden towards the entities.

title: Wolf Collar Color
description: Get the collar color of wolfs.

title: Zombie Drowned Conversion Time
description: Gets the amount of ticks until this entity will be converted to a Drowned as a result of being underwater.

title: Zombie Villager Conversion Player
description: Gets the player who initiated the conversion.

title: Zombie Villager Conversion Time
description: Gets the amount of ticks until this entity will be converted to a Villager as a result of being cured.

title: Zombie Villager Profession
description: Gets the profession of zombie villagers.
syntax_pattern:
[the] zombie villager profession of %livingentities%
%livingentities%'[s] zombie villager profession

title: Merchant Recipe
description: A configuration of effects that defines the firework when exploded.
